svg.aria-label: Three KV residency states under hybrid sparse offloading over one shared GPU block pool; the hot buffer is made of pool pages and top-K selected tokens resolve against resident, hot, then host storage
svg.text: Hybrid sparse offloading: one block pool, three residency states
Hot row = 1 token, in a pool page
Miss — copy row into a hot page
No pressure. All KV on GPU;
batched page copy — stays resident (copy ≠ eviction)
Why the kernel doesn’t care: one slab, constant stride
Hot pages are ordinary blocks from the same pool — the resolver emits physical row IDs; attention gathers with one stride.
